original.product_title: ESR USB-C PD Headphone Jack Adapter, 2-in-1 USB-C to 3.5mm Audio Adapter with Fast Charging for Aux, Stereo, Earphones, Compatible with Samsung Galaxy S21/S20/Note20, iPad mini 6, iPad Pro 2021, Black
original.product_description:
ESR 2-in-1 USB-C PD Headphone Jack Adapter

2-in-1 Audio + Charging: Listen to music with 3.5mm headphones while fast-charging your USB-C device. 

PD+QC Fast Charging: USB-C port supports both PD 2.0 and QC2.0 fast charging

Supports Inline Headphone Controls: Allows you to adjust volume and answer/end calls with your earphones’ inline controls. NOTE: Does not support inline volume control on Apple’s stock 3.5mm EarPods. 

Compatible Models:

- iPad Pro 11/12.9

- 13-inch MacBook Pro

- Samsung S10/S10+/S10e/Note9*/Note8/S9+/S9/S8+/S8

- Google Pixel 3a/3a XL/3/3 XL

- NS

- Nexus 6P/5X

- Huawei MateBook

- OnePlus 5/3T/3/2

- HTC 10

- Lumia 950

- LG V30/V20/G5/G6

- Xiaomi Mi 5, MIX 2S

- And more

*As the Note9’s USB-C port does not connect to its microphone, this device does not support inline microphones when used with the Note9.

Q&A

1.What devices is this adapter compatible with?

The 2-in-1 adapter is compatible with almost any device with a USB Type-C port or a 3.5mm connector.

2.Can I use the volume buttons/call controls on my earphone cable with this adapter?

Yes, the adapter fully supports inline headphone controls. Note: Adapter does not support inline volume control on Apple’s stock 3.5mm EarPods.

3.Will listening to music through this adapter affect charging speed?

No, the adapter is designed for simultaneous audio streaming and PD/QC fast charging. Listening to music will not affect charging speed.
